description: Record the customer's answer about a possible match from find_person_in_crm: that the CRM record is the same person, or a different one. The answer must name the person the search was about (their name, company, e-mail or profile link), or it is refused. Confirming also saves the person's profile link on the record when it has none, provided a search or lookup here returned that link for this person at the company the search named.

decision.description: same_person if the customer says the record is this person, different_person if they say it is someone else

email.description: an e-mail address the person is known by

entity_type.description: contact or lead, as returned with the record

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page; the profile link or an e-mail is needed to remember the answer

record_id.description: the id of the possible match, from find_person_in_crm or add_person_to_crm

name: confirm_possible_match

profile_link.description: for a confirmation: written (saved on the CRM record), already_present, or not saved with the reason

title: Confirm a possible match
